tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: How many components, charts, blocks, templates, patterns and hooks exist, and the categories each is grouped into, with counts. Use a category name as the filter of list_items.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search components, charts, blocks, templates, patterns and hooks by what you need, for example 'date picker', 'pricing section', 'stacked bar chart', 'modal', 'confirm before delete' or 'debounce'. Common synonyms are understood. Returns the best matches with install commands.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List items, optionally filtered by category (a name from list_categories) and type.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Everything about one item: description, props, a usage example, dependencies, accessibility notes, quality checks, docs URL, registry JSON URL and install command.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: The exact shadcn CLI command that installs an item, for npm, pnpm, yarn or bun. Run it in the project's root.

tools.name: get_quality_rules
tools.description: The accessibility, motion, theming and SSR rules every item follows, with why each matters and how to meet it. Read them before writing UI so the first draft already passes.
